property_summary: After Initialized() has been called, the reference contract always prevents changing the LogFile via SetLogFile (SetLogFile must revert or not change the Log), while the mutant allows changing it — so for some input (a log address with malicious behavior) SetLogFile succeeds on the mutant but the reference still forbids it.
change_summary: Removed the initializer check so SetLogFile can be called even after Initialized() was called (deleted the if(intitalized)revert(); guard).
